source: v2.0.0: fresh execution of all 16 quick mathematical scripts; changed M26b executed again with book budget; other book-budget records retained from v1.0.0
scope: synthetic educational experiments; no clinical patient data
note: ch25 Gaussian mean-distribution simulation consumes a different random stream from the original matrix simulation; quick Monte Carlo estimates are not book-budget estimates; v2.0.0 M26b records optimizer retries and undefined calibration slopes for constant/near-constant predictions; finite slope alone is not an optimization check. Strongly regularized near-constant predictions may have AUC affected by floating-point residual variation.
